overview: The block-action packet (chest open, piston, note block) has a single corpus hit: Artemis registers a GPacketPlayServerBlockAction wrapper in its packet library so the abstraction layer can route the clientbound packet. The wrapper is a read-stub: its read() body is empty, and no Artemis check consumes the packet. No anticheat flags S24 or derives state from it, because it carries transient animation data with no movement, timing or position claim.

checks.name: Packet wrapper registration (Artemis)
checks.purpose: Register the block-action packet in Artemis's packet abstraction so clientbound traffic of this type is recognized by the pipeline.
checks.how_it_works: GPacketPlayServerBlockAction extends GPacket and is linked to the PacketPlayServerBlockAction interface via @PacketLink. The read() method is empty, so the wrapper decodes no fields; it exists purely so the packet has a typed class in the cc.ghast.packet wrapper tree. No check in the corpus reads its payload.
checks.detects: Nothing. The entry documents the only anticheat touch point for S24: packet-library plumbing, not detection logic.
checks.variations: No other anticheat in the corpus references S24PacketBlockAction or PacketPlayOutBlockAction.
